scripts.agent-pm: pkill -f 'manage.py runserver' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f daphne 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'vite' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'ngrok' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "$PWD/backend/.venv/bin/celery" 2>/dev/null; sh scripts/stop-voice-stack.sh; sleep 1 && (redis-cli -u ${REDIS_URL:-redis://localhost:6379/0} ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Redis is not running on ${REDIS_URL:-redis://localhost:6379/0}. Start it (e.g. brew services start redis) — the 5-minute Google sync, reminders and Airtable/Salesforce syncs need it.' && exit 1)) && concurrently --names "django,react,ngrok,worker,beat" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue" "cd backend && .venv/bin/daphne -b 0.0.0.0 -p 8000 core.asgi:application" "sleep 3 && cd frontend && npm run dev" "ngrok http --url=untouched-roving-procurer.ngrok-free.dev 8000" "cd backend && $PWD/backend/.venv/bin/celery -A core.celery worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2" "cd backend && $PWD/backend/.venv/bin/celery -A core.celery beat --loglevel=info --schedule=/tmp/agentpm-celerybeat-schedule"
